scripts.text: - You have too many items. Please make space. -
scripts.translation: - 物品太多了，请腾出空间。-

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
Look... the Magic Academy
in Geffen is now directly
selling the brand new
^007777Universal Catalog Silver^000000!
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
看...吉芬魔法学院现在直接出售全新的^007777露天商店检索卡(银)^000000！

scripts.text:
He is looking at the words
written on his hand.
He seems too busy
to look at you.
scripts.translation:
他正低头看着写在手上的字。
他好像太忙了，顾不上看你。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
A brand new catalog
has just come out!
You can check
what items you can trade
and what items are on sale
from the vendor.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
新款目录刚刚推出！
用它就能查询商人正在出售哪些物品。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The ^007777Universal Catalog Silver^000000
costs only 200z!
You can buy up to 50 pieces at once!
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
^007777露天商店检索卡(银)^000000只要200 Zeny！
一次最多可以买50张！

scripts.text: You don't look like a vendor!

[Catalog Magician]
You... want all 50 pieces?
Or how many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
你...要买整整50张？
还是说，你想买多少张？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
It should be less than 50 pieces.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
购买数量要少于50张。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The trade has been stopped!
I don't know what to do next...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
交易被中断了！
我不知道接下来该怎么办...
我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The total number of catalog(s) that you're trying to purchase is {0} pieces.
It costs {1} z.
Ok, here you go.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
你要买{0}张目录，共计{1} Zeny。
好的，给你。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
The total number of catalog(s) that you're trying to purchase is {0} pieces.
It costs {1} z.
It seems you don't have enough money.
You can sell your equipment
to make more money... if you want.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
你要买{0}张目录，共计{1} Zeny。
看来你的钱不够。
要不卖掉一些装备凑钱...当然，随你。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
Argh... you really need this
item... Do you want me to
explain again? I don't know
what to do next...
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
啊...你真的很需要这个东西...要我再解释一遍吗？
我不知道接下来该怎么办...
该怎么办才好？

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
My real job is a magician.
I was going to ask the merchant
guild to sell them, but they were
trying use them as an appendix
into broom sales. That's why
I'm selling these by myself.
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
其实我是个魔法师。
我本来想请商人公会代售这些目录，可他们居然想把目录当作卖扫帚的赠品。
所以我只好自己来卖了。

scripts.text:
[Catalog Magician]
There are many adventurers
here who come and go.
I'm pretty sure that I can sell to all of them soon.
Don't you think so?
So... let's start!! Buy more of them, please! PLEASE...!
scripts.translation:
[目录魔法师]
这里来往的冒险者这么多，肯定很快就能卖光。
你说是吧？
那么...快来买吧！！多买一点！拜托了...！
